description: This file contains CSS styles and variables for managing themes, including light and dark themes, for a frontend application.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main class for the application, applies background and text color based on theme variables.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styling for the application logo, with animation support when reduced motion is not preferred.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header styling for the application, centers content and styles background and text colors.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Link styling that changes color based on theme variables.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button styling for toggling themes, featuring hover and active states.
